title: Single-molecule biophysics experiments in silico: Toward a physical model of a replisome.
authors: Maffeo, Christopher; Chou, Han-Yi; Aksimentiev, Aleksei
one_liner_zh: 该文通过原子模拟与粗粒化建模在计算机中复现单分子实验，研究DNA结合蛋白与单链DNA的力学互作及复制叉复合物，虽非典型TF-DNA体系，但蛋白-DNA互作建模方法可迁移至TF-DNA研究。
abstract: The interpretation of single-molecule experiments is frequently aided by computational modeling of biomolecular dynamics. The growth of computing power and ongoing validation of computational models suggest that it soon may be possible to replace some experiments outright with computational mimics. Here, we offer a blueprint for performing single-molecule studies in silico using a DNA-binding protein as a test bed. We demonstrate how atomistic simulations, typically limited to sub-millisecond durations and zeptoliter volumes, can guide development of a coarse-grained model for use in simulations that mimic single-molecule experiments. We apply the model to recapitulate, in silico, force-extension characterization of protein binding to single-stranded DNA and protein and DNA replacement assays, providing a detailed portrait of the underlying mechanics. Finally, we use the model to simulate the trombone loop of a replication fork, a large complex of proteins and DNA.
abstract_zh: 单分子实验的解读常常借助生物分子动力学的计算建模。计算能力的增长以及计算模型的持续验证表明，不久之后，用计算模拟完全替代某些实验可能成为可能。在此，我们提供一个蓝图，用于以DNA结合蛋白为测试平台，在计算机中（in silico）进行单分子研究。我们展示了原子级模拟（通常限于亚毫秒持续时间和仄升（zeptoliter）体积）如何指导开发一个粗粒化模型，用于模拟单分子实验的仿真。我们将该模型应用于在计算机中重现蛋白质与单链DNA结合的力-延伸表征，以及蛋白质和DNA置换实验，提供了底层力学的详细描绘。最后，我们使用该模型模拟复制叉的伸缩环（trombone loop），这是一个由蛋白质和DNA组成的大型复合体。
